confidence_notes: Restaurant and beer anchors come from 2026 cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo-based and guide sites) and are cross-checked against each other, with a July tourist-season uplift applied. Coffee and wine are less certain: the wine basis is mostly Lisbon and general Portugal guidance, and cocktail is derived from Algarve listing sites rather than a Faro survey. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, with no accommodation search or live listing checks. EUR to USD uses about 1.17, implied from a Portugal Buyers Agent conversion; it is not part of the RBA observation. The RBA rate was taken from a search snippet quoting the 4pm reference rate for 18 November 2026, and I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Portugal's national restaurant and beer indices, adjusted upward for Faro's higher-than-national restaurant and beer pricing and its Algarve tourist-season pricing in July. Cocktail and wine use Algarve bar listings and Portuguese beer-to-drink relationships. Accommodation uses a holistic estimate for a mid-sized southern Portuguese coastal tourist city in peak summer, not a comparable-city lookup.
